senses.gloss:
Sigh,Ⓒs.Ⓓni(niH)SvAsaH, ucCvAsaH, ucCva-sitaM, dIrGaSvAsaH-niSvAsaH &c.
Ⓔv. i.ⒹdIrGaM ni-ut-Svas 2 P, niSvAsaM muc or sfj 6 P; ‘s(igh)ing deep and hot’ dIrGaM uzRaM ca niSvasya.
Ⓑ
 2 Suc 1 P, rud 2 P; See Lament.
Ⓝ[Sigh]ing,Ⓒa.ⒹniSvAsin, ucCvAsin, dIrGaniSvAsin, saniSvAsa.

Sign,Ⓒs.ⒹcihnaM, lakzaRaM, liMgaM, aBijYAnaM, lAM-CanaM, vyaMjanaM-kaM; ‘a bad s(ign)’; ava-dur-lakzaRaM.
Ⓑ
 2 saMjYA, saMketaH, iMgitaM.
Ⓑ
 3 Portent, q. v.
Ⓑ
 4 rASiH.
Ⓑ
 5 cihnaM (in Math. &c.); ‘s(ign) manual’ svahastaH, svAkzaraM, svahastAkzaraM; ‘under oneʼs own s(ign) manual’ svahasta-paricihnita (Y. ii. 93).
Ⓑ
 6 DvajaH; ‘s(ign)-post’ DvajastaMBaH.
Ⓔv.Ⓓ‘make a sign’ saMjYAM dA 3 U; ‘understand the s(ign)’ saMjYAM grah 9 U; ‘makes a s(ign) to Vidushaka’ vidUzakaM saMjYAM laMBayati; ‘s(ign)ed to him by her eyes to come’ netrasaMjYayA taM Ahvayat; guruM netrasahasreRa nodayAmAsa vAsavaH (K. ii. 29) ‘s(ign)ed to speak &c.’.
Ⓑ
 2 nAma liK 6 P or niviS c. (with loc.); svAkzareRa aMk 10 or cihnayati; (D.).
Ⓝ[Sign]atory,Ⓒs.ⒹsvanAma-leKakaH-niveSakaH.
Ⓝ[Sign]ature,Ⓒs.ⒹnAmaleKanaM-niveSanaM.
Ⓑ
 2 nAmAkzaraM, hastAkzaraM.
ⓃSignal,Ⓒs.ⒹsaMjYA, saMketaH.
Ⓔa.ⒹapUrva, ananyasADAraRa (RI f.), viSizwa, smaraRArha, atyutkfzwa, viSeza in comp.
Ⓝ[Signal]ize,Ⓒv. t.ⒹprasidDI-viSrutI-kf 8 U; (oneself) kIrtiM-pratizWAM-yaSaH-prAp 5 P or laB 1 A.
Ⓝ[Signal]ly,Ⓒadv.Ⓓati, nitarAM, atyaMtaM, apUrvatayA.
ⓃSignet,Ⓒs.ⒹmudrA; ‘s(ignet)-ring’ mudrAsanATamaMgulIyaM, aMgulimudrA.
ⓃSignify,Ⓒv. t.ⒹbuD c., gam c., dyut c., aBi-DA 3 U; See Indicate, Mean; oft. ex. by arTaH; ‘what does it s(ignify)’ asya korTaH, kimanena gamyate, &c.; ‘it s(ignifi)es much’ gurvarTametat.
Ⓑ
 2 by gOravaM, mahattvaM, BAraH.
Ⓑ
 3 by Sakti f., balaM.
Ⓝ[Signif]icance,Ⓒs.ⒹgOravaM, mahattvaM.
Ⓝ[Signif]icant, [Signif]icative,Ⓒa.ⒹsArTa, caritArTa, arTa-yukta, samarTa, arTAnvita, arTavat, pUrRArTa.
Ⓑ
 2 hetugarBa, sAkUta, aBiprAyagarBa; ‘casting at me a s(ignificant) look’ sAkUtaM mAM nirvarRya.
Ⓑ
 3 vA-caka, aBiDAyaka, darSaka, sUcaka.
Ⓑ
 4 guru, mahat.
Ⓝ[Signif]icantly,Ⓒadv.ⒹarTavat, sAkUtaM, sArTaM, pUrRArTataH.
Ⓝ[Signif]ication,Ⓒs.ⒹarTaH.
Ⓑ
 2 SaktiH.
